Between 7 and 11 p.m. on the 3/4/37, a Radio Van patrolled Dixwell Road and Kashing Road districts. No searching done in the Dixwell Road district and no reports.

JAPANESE SPRING
FESTIVAL.
Between 10 a.m. and 11.30 a.m. 3/4/37, diplomatic, Consular, Naval and Military Officials attended the Shanghai Shrine on Kiangwan Road on the occasion of the Japanese Spring Festival.
Between 1 p.m. and 2 p.m. 3/4/37, aged Japanese residents were invited to attended the Shanghai Shrine.
Precautionary measures and traffic arrangements were made by officers of this station under Inspector i/c.
There were no untoward incidents.

Saturday, 4th. April 1936.
5771
4 4 36

JAPANESE
SPRING FES-
TIVAL.
The Japanese Spring Festival celebration was held at
the Japanese Shrine, Kiangwan Road, between the hours of
10.a.m. and 12 noon, on the 3-4-36, when the following
persons attended :-

Rear-Admiral Kondo,

Rear-Admiral Sato (Resident office),

Deputation Minister Nakasugi,

Consul General Ishii.

The function was presided over by Mr. Amano, Chairman
of the Japanese Residents Corporation.

Nothing of an untoward nature happened.

ATTEMPTED
SUICIDE OF
JAPANESE SUB-
JECT.
At 11.30.p.m. 3-4-36, a telephone message was received
from the Foo King Hospital requesting the services of a
Japanese Police Officer. Inquiries learned that a male
Japanese named Takehiko Hattori, aged 38 years, residing and
employed as a stoker at the Kabuki Theatre, 134 North Sze-
chuen Road, had attempted to commit suicide by committing
"Harakiri", at 11.0.p.m. 3-4-36 in the store hold of the
theatre. Doctor's certificate reads:- "Harakiri", Incised
wound in abdomen, May be serious." After treatment he was
allowed to go home. Japanese Consular Police in attendance
on arrival of Officer from this station.

Reason for attempting to commit suicide not disclosed.

CHAPEI FIRE
ENGINES USING
MUNICIPAL RD.
At 6.40.p.m. 3-4-36, 2 fire engines of the 2nd. Div.
and 2 of the 3rd. Division of Chapel Fire Brigade were seen
proceeding West to East along Dixwell Road with carillon
bells ringing.

PATROL
(RADIO VAN)
No.90
Between 11.p.m. 3-4-36 and 7.a.m. 4-4-36, a Radio Van
patrolled Dixwell Road and Kashing Road districts. No search
ing done in the Dixwell Road district and no reports.

Officer i/c

D.C. Daws,
Officer i/c Political Brh.

日本

日。
1936年4月3日上午10时至中午12时，在江湾路日本神社举行了日本春季节日庆典，出席人员如下：-

近藤海军少将，

佐藤海军少将（居留民团事务所），

中杉特派公使，

石井总领事。

该活动由日本居留民团团长天野先生主持。

未发生任何意外性质的事件。

日本侨民
自杀未遂。
1936年4月3日晚11时30分，接福金医院（Foo King Hospital）电话，请求派遣一名日本警官。经查询获悉，一名名为服部武彦（Takehiko Hattori）、38岁的日本男子，居住并受雇于北四川路134号歌舞伎剧院担任司炉，于1936年4月3日晚11时在剧院货舱内试图通过“切腹”自杀。医生证明写道：“切腹”，腹部割伤，可能严重。”治疗后获准回家。本局警官到达时，日本领事警察已在场。

自杀未遂原因未披露。

闸北消防
车使用公
共租界道
路。
1936年4月3日晚6时40分，看到闸北消防队第二分队2辆消防车和第三分队2辆消防车鸣响钟铃，沿狄思威路由西向东行驶。

S.I. Special Branch
April 2, 1935.

Spring Festival to be observed at the Shanghai Shrine,
Xiangwan Road, on April 3.

A ceremony in connection with the Spring Festival will
be held at the Shanghai Shrine, Xiangwan Road, between 10 a.m.
and 11.30 a.m. April 3.

Invitations have been sent out to prominent Japanese
officials and residents, but according to an official of the
shrine, the attendance of notables will be small. However,
it is expected that a large number of the Japanese public
will pay their respects at the shrine during the course of
the ceremony.

Between 2 p.m. and 2.30 p.m. a service will be held
in honour of aged persons. Some 60 persons have been invited.
Following the service, musical performances and dances will
be staged for their entertainment by children of various
Japanese institutions. The proceedings are expected to
terminate at about 4 p.m.

The following members of the Special Branch will
perform observation duty in the vicinity of the Shrine during
the above mentioned proceedings :-

Subject Spring Festival Celebration at Japanese Shrine, Kiangwan Road.
Made by D.S.I. Tentstall Forwarded by Inspr. EDO Eve

Sir,
The Spring festival was celebrated at the Japanese Shrine,
Kiangwan Road on 3-4-35. From 10 a.m. to 11 a.m. a religious
service was held. The afternoon programme which was to have
been in the nature of an entertainment, was considerably
curtailed owing to the unsuitable weather and commencing at
2 p.m., concluded at 3 p.m. uniform and detective parties from
Dixwell Road Station were in attendance as also were detectives
of the Special Branch. D. O. "C" and D. D. O. "C" Division
attended.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

J. Titchell
D. S. I.

此致，
敬礼，

您的顺从仆人，

主题：4月3日将在江湾路上海神社观察春季节日。
撰写人：D. S. Umemoto. 转呈人：H Grubb A/S

1935年4月3日上午10时至11时30分，将在江湾路上海神社举行与春季节日相关的仪式。

已向日本知名官员和居民发出邀请，但据神社官员称，知名人士的出席人数将很少。然而，预计在日本公众将在仪式期间前往神社致敬的人数众多。

下午2时至2时30分之间，将举行向长者致敬的法事。已邀请约60人。
法事后，将由各日本机构的儿童上演音乐表演和舞蹈以供娱乐。预计活动将于下午4时左右结束。

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. 5771 / C. & S. B. REGISTRY. / Dixwell Rd. Station, / Date April 5, 1934）

Subject (in full) Religious ceremonies held at the Shanghai Shrine, Kiangwan Road.

Made by D.S.I. White Forwarded by

Sir,

Commencing at 10 a.m. the 3-4-34, religious ceremonies in connection with the anniversary of the "Japanese Imperial Family Ancestry" and the "Spring Festival" were conducted at the Shanghai Shrine, Kiangwan Road.

The services were attended by Lt. Commander Kobetto, Naval Attaché, Lt. Commander Shibakita, representative of the Japanese Naval Landing Party, representatives of the various Japanese communal organisations in Shanghai and about 700 civilians. No Japanese naval, military or diplomatic representatives attended. The services terminated at 12 noon.

Between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. same date, various entertainments were staged at the Shrine for the benefit of the Japanese aged people.

Municipal Police, of Dixwell Road Station, augmented with Japanese detectives from Hongkew Station and Special Branch, with Japanese details from Uniform Branch, Kashing Road Station, officiated under supervision of Officer i/c of District, in conjunction with members of the Japanese Consular Police.

Nothing untoward occurred during the day's proceedings.

R.J White
D. S. I.

（批：4/6 3/4）

O/C Special Branch.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 5771 / C. & S. B. 登记处。/ 狄思威路捕房，/ 日期 1934年4月5日）

事由（全称） 江湾路上海神社举行的宗教仪式。

由 副督察长 怀特 制作 转呈

先生，

自1934年4月3日上午10时起，在江湾路上海神社举行了与“日本皇室祖先祭”及“春节”周年纪念相关的宗教仪式。

出席礼拜仪式的有海军武官科贝托（Kobetto，音译）中佐、日本海军陆战队代表柴北（Shibakita，音译）中佐、上海各日本侨民团体的代表以及约700名平民。没有日本海军、军事或外交代表出席。仪式于中午12时结束。

同日午后2时至4时之间，神社内举办了各种娱乐活动，以供日本长者消遣。

狄思威路捕房的市警警力，在虹口捕房及特别处的日本侦探，以及嘉善路捕房制服科的日本警员的增援下，在区主管警官的监督下，会同日本领事警察成员执行了勤务。

当日活动期间未发生任何意外事件。

R.J. 怀特
副督察长

（批注：4/6 3/4）

特别处主管警官。

Subject (in full) Festival at the Shanghai Shrine, Kiangwan Road.
Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

The spring festival of the Shanghai Shrine will be celebrated
at the shrine, Kiangwan Road, at 10 a.m. April 3, 1934. The
function will be presided over by Mr. Yasui, Chairman of the
Administrative Board of the Japanese Residents Corporation.
Invitations have been sent out to prominent Japanese officials
and residents but according to a staff of the shrine, the attendance
of notables will be very doubtful. However, it is expected that
a large number of Japanese public will pay their respects at the
shrine.
The proceedings will terminate at about 11.30 a.m.
During the afternoon, some 50 aged persons will be invited
to the shrine where musical performances and cinematograph films
will be staged for their entertainment.

D. S. Umemoto
D. S.
